time-zone.title: Reporting time zone
time-zone.description: Where a day starts in Operations: every tile, chart and range cuts its days, weeks and months in this time zone, for every admin. The server’s is {{zone}}.
time-zone.label: Time zone
time-zone.invalid: Not a time zone name. Pick one from the list, like Europe/Madrid.

session-gap.title: Sessions
session-gap.description_one: Activity and Value count a chat’s messages as one session until nobody writes for this long. A change applies to every range at once. The server’s is {{count, number}} minute.
session-gap.description_other: Activity and Value count a chat’s messages as one session until nobody writes for this long. A change applies to every range at once. The server’s is {{count, number}} minutes.
session-gap.label: Gap in minutes
session-gap.invalid: A whole number from {{min, number}} to {{max, number}}.

retention.title: Collection and retention
retention.description: Retention is in days. Zero disables pruning for that setting. Analytics rollups also depend on retained analytics facts; source agent runs are always kept. Changes are recorded in the workspace audit.

price-sync.title: Price sync
price-sync.description: Once a day, Socio downloads the public price lists of model providers (OpenRouter, DeepInfra, Azure, AWS) and community lists (models.dev, LiteLLM) and keeps the prices of the models in use, so Cost can price turns. The requests carry a generic user agent and nothing about this workspace, its people or this server. Turn it off for an offline install: then no list is read, and turns are priced by the prices kept and admins’ own. The server’s is {{state}}.
